mapper.select: select wr.id, wr.course_id, cast(null as bigint) custom_course_id, c.title course_title, wr.duration_minutes, wr.completion_percent, wr.started_at, wr.completed_at from workout_records wr join courses c on c.id = wr.course_id where wr.id = #{id} and wr.user_id = #{userId}

select cwr.id, cast(null as bigint) course_id, cwr.custom_course_id, cc.title course_title, cwr.duration_minutes, cwr.completion_percent, cwr.started_at, cwr.completed_at from custom_workout_records cwr join custom_courses cc on cc.id = cwr.custom_course_id where cwr.id = #{id} and cwr.user_id = #{userId}

select * from ( select wr.id, wr.course_id, cast(null as bigint) custom_course_id, c.title course_title, wr.duration_minutes, wr.completion_percent, wr.started_at, wr.completed_at from workout_records wr join courses c on c.id = wr.course_id where wr.user_id = #{userId} union all select cwr.id, cast(null as bigint) course_id, cwr.custom_course_id, cc.title course_title, cwr.duration_minutes, cwr.completion_percent, cwr.started_at, cwr.completed_at from custom_workout_records cwr join custom_courses cc on cc.id = cwr.custom_course_id where cwr.user_id = #{userId} ) history order by completed_at desc limit #{limit}
